answer: AMD's total assets changed by -17.5% from fiscal year 2014 to fiscal year 2015. Total assets decreased from $3,767 million as of December 27, 2014, to $3,109 million as of December 26, 2015.
rationale: Total assets were $3,767 million in FY 2014 and $3,109 million in FY 2015 per AMD's Consolidated Balance Sheets. The percentage change is (3109 - 3767) / 3767 * 100 = -17.46748%, which rounds to -17.5%.
